info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Data Retrieval API provides access to critical market data based on specific parameters. Developers can utilize this API to fetch detailed information related to market data switch administration, which is essential for financial analyses and decision-making. Typical consumers of this API include financial analysts and software systems requiring up-to-date market information. By querying with the provided 'param1', users can retrieve tailored market data insights, facilitating enhanced operational efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve Market Data Switch Administration Details
get.description: Fetches the details of the specified market data switch administration identified by RES-100045. This endpoint allows users to access critical information regarding market data configurations and settings.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving market data switch administration for a specific resource. This request is intended to fetch details about the specified market data switch operation identified by RES-100045.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the requested market data.
